_comment: Calibration of each reference drawing: model (h, v) in mm -> page pixel (u, v) = A @ [h, v, 1]. The images themselves are not in git; put them in ref/ (see README).

side._source: Revell 04394 Halifax B/GR II Srs IA instructions, page 14, rendered at 400 dpi. Lower side view (nose right). 0.2042 mm per px; the drawing is tilted slightly, hence the x term in the second row.

plan._source: Same page, underside plan view (nose down, starboard on the left). 0.253 mm per px.
